title: One Automations page with tabs
problem: Automatic work was spread over seven pages and menus.
now: Automations has tabs for each rule area, AI rules, notifications, cart reminders, smart offers and auto-call; the other pages sit under it.
steps: Tap AI to see Grid AI's rules
Tap Reminders and open the reminder settings
Check the menu lights Automations there
left: Grid AI › Automations keeps its own row in Grid AI so the Retail edition still reaches it; the AI tab here shows the same rules.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
